Card Q&A.a: As with the standard rules, a used Option card is temporarily treated as not being in any area. After using it and activating the Option card's [Main] effect, the card is trashed unless it's to be placed in an area.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to use an Option card from under a Tamer, what happens to that Option card?

Card Q&A.a: It can be activated after activating the used Option card's [Main] effect.
Card Q&A.q: If the "when you use an Option card" effect triggers, what is the timing when it can activate?

Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't trigger. If an Option card's effect activates without using it, such as activation by a [Security] effect or , the "when you use an Option card" effect doesn't trigger.
Card Q&A.q: Does the "when you use an Option card" effect trigger if an Option card's effect activates by a method other than using the card?

Card Q&A.a: [Security] effects take precedence for activation. Upon a security check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation. For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.
Card Q&A.q: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

I tried to use this card's [All Turns] effect to place an opponent's Digimon as the bottom security card, but another effect prevented that Digimon from leaving. At such times, does this effect trash an opponent's security card?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it counts. A use of [X Per Turn] occurs as soon as you choose to activate the effect. In this case, a use of [Once Per Turn] occurs as soon as you choose to place an opponent's Digimon as the bottom security card.
Card Q&A.q: I tried to use this card's [All Turns] effect to place an opponent's Digimon as the bottom security card, but another effect prevented that Digimon from leaving. At such times, does it count as a use of this effect's [Once Per Turn]?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may use 1 Option card with the [Onmyōjutsu] or [Plug-In] trait from your hand or under your Tamers without paying the cost.

[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When you use Option cards or your security stack is removed from, by placing 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP as the bottom security card, trash their top security card.
